record_requirements.label: Defined Emergency
record_requirements.question: What current threat or restoration need makes ordinary access procedure too slow, and what material harm increases with delay?

record_requirements.label: Engagement & Incident
record_requirements.question: Which Open Engagement and declared active Incident establish the Client and professional-accountability boundary?

record_requirements.label: Named Actor & Account
record_requirements.question: Is one identified person using one attributable account without shared identity?

record_requirements.label: Minimum Scope
record_requirements.question: Are system, environment, permissions, purpose, permitted actions, and prohibited actions explicit and least-privileged?

record_requirements.label: Emergency Risk
record_requirements.question: Are impact, data sensitivity, risk owner, controls, and residual risk explicit?

record_requirements.label: Independent Authority
record_requirements.question: Are Client emergency authority, Firm emergency authority, and independent security approval explicit and evidenced?

record_requirements.label: Absolute Time Boundary
record_requirements.question: Are activation and expiry timestamps fixed, ordered, and incapable of silent renewal?

record_requirements.label: Identity & Credential Controls
record_requirements.question: Are MFA, credential custody, vault reference, session attribution, and post-use rotation defined without storing secrets?

record_requirements.label: Activation Record
record_requirements.question: Who activated access, when, under which approvals, and with what verification evidence?

record_requirements.label: Complete Activity Log
record_requirements.question: Are material commands, actions, targets, results, actors, times, and evidence recorded?

record_requirements.label: Independent Monitoring
record_requirements.question: Who monitored the emergency session independently and how were scope violations escalated?

record_requirements.label: Expiry & Revocation
record_requirements.question: Did authority end automatically and was technical removal independently verified?

record_requirements.label: Client Disclosure
record_requirements.question: Was use disclosed promptly to the Client and Responsible Partner with factual evidence?

record_requirements.label: Retrospective Review
record_requirements.question: Did an independent reviewer assess necessity, authority, scope, actions, outcome, credential handling, and control performance?

record_requirements.label: Corrective Action & Closure
record_requirements.question: Are follow-up actions owned, access removal verified, evidence complete, and closure separately authorized?
